anchor.problem: Repeated scheduling/key/state work when scoring mutually exclusive fixed-topology cell-sizing alternatives from one base checkpoint
anchor.engineering_user: Timing-optimization developer using a timing engine for candidate selection
anchor.downstream_need: Obtain identical scoped per-candidate endpoint results and caller decision with lower fully charged iteration cost
anchor.causal_mechanism: Candidate-membership mask partition refinement across complete deterministic timing operation records, with split on dependency differences and full-output equality coalescence
mechanism_invariants: Same fixed candidate set/base revision and scalar kernels/arithmetic/tie ordering
Complete observable context including candidate pin-cap/load changes and timing tags; hashes only index full equality
Disjoint covering candidate masks; no combining alternative edits
Strong cached incremental/transactional/task-clustered comparison gets the same inputs, memory, batching and reporting
Unsupported or capped work replays exact original candidate through reference with all costs charged
Initial exactness is conditional and scoped; real adapter and demand must be established
forbidden_pivots: Replace the anchor with generic predict-then-check, agent count, extra trials or model training
Claim kernel-count superiority over complete-key memoization from the toy
Count work already skipped by scalar incremental propagation as saved
Change to a proxy without demonstrated caller decision benefit
Expand to MCMM/hold/SI/production signoff without explicit proof and coverage audit

combination_drift.rationale: Identical mask anchor retained with strengthened common-operation/lifetime negative result; no substitute method or invented gain. Merit unresolved is separate from drift.

demand_drift.rationale: Frozen full-vector sizing contract retained; prospective smaller-statistic result is adverse evidence, not a change of output or user.

changes: Complete bounded adapter read/operation/lifetime witness pass: none found
Complete prospective consumer/sufficient-statistic test; materialized vector need unresolved
Reopen favorable scope and adjacent fidelity source; repair actual baseline path
Recommend parking without joint abandonment or successor
revision_assessment.reason: Concrete negative source/analytical progress preserves the original contract; both witness gates fail advancement.

resurrection_conditions: Concrete caller-required capability or cost/reliability delta beyond faithful EDA-adapted B++ under matched information/memory/adaptation
Actual or independently justified prospective consumer of unchanged full-vector contract that survives sufficient-smaller-query comparisons
After BOTH witnesses: full state/FP/recovery, compatible binary, rights, named owners, real allocation and matching task-list consents before experiments
